effect_description_eng:
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Unsuspend up to 2 of your Digimon with [Garurumon] in their names (other than [KendoGarurumon]) or [Hybrid] trait.
[On Deletion] You may play 1 blue level 4 or below Digimon card with the [Hybrid] trait from your hand without paying its memory cost.
